t: The Fortress Trade 9" Cage Roller Frame is a robust painting tool for professional decorators and DIY enthusiasts. It provides superior control for smooth, even paint application and precise paint release across various surfaces. This durable roller frame is ideal for large-area tasks, such as painting walls and ceilings in residential and commercial properties, including new builds and refurbishments. Its lightweight design and reinforced glass fibre construction ensure long-lasting performance and reduced user fatigue. The frame is compatible with all 9" roller sleeves and UK screw fixing extension poles, offering versatility and extended reach for painting projects.
b: Compatible with 9" Sleeves & UK Screw Fixing Extension Poles
